findings.claim: KLA 10-K FY2026 describes a highly concentrated customer base (orders from a limited number of manufacturers are a substantial portion of sales; foundry/logic a significant portion of orders); the filing excerpt does not mention any customer second-sourcing or in-house of KLA's process control.
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We are exposed to risks associated with a highly concentrated customer base. Our customer base, particularly in the semiconductor industry, historically has been highly concentrated due to corporate consolidation, acquisitions and business closures.

note: Two WebSearches found no report of KLA's largest customer introducing a second supplier or in-housing inspection/metrology. The 10-Q (Mar 2026) reports anonymous customers at ~19% and ~11% of revenue. Only 2 of 4 searches used.
